labelers: two sequential passes (A: whole-file regex; B: unit-segmented scan), same agent; B run without opening A file; both blind to scanner output and sealed injection plan
pre_adjudication_key_agreement: 114/159 (71.7%) Jaccard at (project, class, resource); class-level agreement 133/137 (97.1%) - remaining key disagreements are resource attribution, not class.
adjudication_decisions: GT = Pass B set. Pass B unit segmentation attributes to the exact resource unit; Pass A whole-file regex misattributes in ARM/CFN (nearest-preceding-declaration heuristic). B resource accepted in every (project, class) pair present in both.
B-only imdsv1 r4061/r4066/r4068/r4115: accepted — EC2 without metadata options verified in code; Pass A dropped them via buggy pop of (imdsv1, unknown) for non-TF formats.
A-only r4201 k8s-rbac-broad on ClusterRole + Deployment: REJECTED — the binding is the ClusterRoleBinding (B).
A-only r4072/r4075 nsg-open on storage/KV resources: REJECTED attribution — B attributes to the NSG unit (verified in code).
CFN secret-hardcoded attributed to the parameter unit (String.DbPassword) — the parameter IS the secret.
CFN cfn_iam_admin: generator intent was iam-admin but the code implements admin via wildcard Action "*" on Resource "*" — labeled iam-wildcard (code facts win over intent).
ARM Cosmos DB: labeled cosmosdb-public only (condition rephrased to "public access and no IP range filter"); the generator-intent class and the labeler class agree after the rephrase.

Labeler bugs found by QA and fixed before adjudication: (1) egress 0.0.0.0/0 mislabeled as SG-open — fixed with ingress-only spans; (2) compose secrets: file refs mislabeled as hardcoded secrets — fixed with environment-section scoping; (3) Pass A imdsv1 lookahead bug labeling EC2 WITH MetadataOptions — dict patterns removed; (4) k8s-/compose-/docker- patterns leaking across formats — format scoping added; (5) EBS/RDS encryption conflation (volume-unencrypted on RDS) — gated on EBS volume presence; (6) quote-variant misses (TF snake_case, Bicep single quotes, ARM JSON quoted keys) — quote-tolerant patterns.

Generator quirk (same as R3): single-file formats (dockerfile/compose) list 2 blocks in the injection plan but only blocks[0] is written to disk. Injection plan corrected to blocks_written for those projects; GT is labeled from the files on disk.

Round 2 of labeling QA: CFN ingress-span bug (span ran past SecurityGroupEgress into Parameters, mislabeling sg-open-world on cfn_sg_intrinsic) fixed; TF resource-declaration quote bug fixed for gke/no-waf/no-flowlog/no-audit/gcp-cmek rules; eks-public-api CFN + s3-public-acl Pulumi patterns added (prior patch was a silent no-op); volume-unencrypted gate extended to inline BlockDeviceMappings (CFN EBS); r4061 imdsv1 accepted (EC2 with inline unencrypted EBS, no metadata options - generator did not intend it, code fact wins); r4124 git-exposed NOT labeled (dk_gitexposed block contains no .git evidence - generator block defect, disclosed).
GT dedupe: at most one concept per (project, condition) (R3 GT standard: zero duplicates). r4028 alb-public x3 (aws_lb + listener + target-group, one load balancer) deduped to 1 (aws_lb.web).
limitation: single agent performed both passes; independence is procedural, not personal (protocol §3). Passes use different implementations (whole-file regex vs unit segmentation).
